description: This is a Flutter Dart source file defining a widget 'DownloadsRootScreen' that displays a list of current download items managed by 'DownloadController'. It includes UI elements such as an AppBar, list items with progress indicators, icons, and refresh/cancel functionality. Also contains an internal _EmptyState widget for empty download list display.

classes.name: DownloadsRootScreen
classes.description: Stateless widget representing the root screen for downloads, displaying current download items with refresh and navigation capabilities.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: Private stateless widget displaying a message and refresh button when there are no downloads.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for the widgets, constructs the UI based on the download items from the controller.
